title: 三大模型承诺暂停？：他说别误读，安全机制才是关键
speaker: Micah Hill Smith

segments.en: should we believe what they said, the three? Yes, but we should read what they've said carefully,
segments.zh: 我们该相信这三家说的吗？该信，但要仔细读他们到底说了什么。

segments.en: they haven't said that they are committing now to a broad AI pause. We're talking about mechanisms to pace the frontier to do more safety work in order to make sure that they can safely release these models,
segments.zh: 他们并没有承诺现在就全面暂停AI。我们讨论的是给前沿模型设定节奏的机制，做更多安全方面的工作，确保能安全地发布这些模型。

segments.en: they're not saying they're not going to release them. This comes as a capstone call it on several months of increasing temperature on the conversation around all of these models,
segments.zh: 他们并不是说不发布这些模型了。这可以说是过去几个月围绕这些模型讨论不断升温的一个总结。

segments.en: we've been seeing capability thresholds, especially around cyber capabilities being crossed and being of interest to a broad range of players,
segments.zh: 我们看到一些能力门槛被跨过，尤其是网络相关能力，引起了广泛参与者的关注。

segments.en: and we've seen several incidents now in the last couple of months that have got a lot of attention, including the open AI hooking phase incident,
segments.zh: 过去几个月出现了几起引发大量关注的事件，包括OpenAI的那起事件。

segments.en: that have made it very clear that the building and deployment of these models is creating real risks.
segments.zh: 这些事件清楚地表明，这些模型的构建和部署正在带来真实的风险。
